capabilities.scope: One unopened factory YS-M33 completed backup, unlock, EmberBSD installation and a normal eMMC restart over USB-C with separate DC power and no UART. This does not qualify a fleet installer or another factory image.
An installed FFSv2 root on the UDISK eMMC partition booted on one factory sample. Cold power-cycle acceptance and full Android restoration remain untested.
Bounded speaker playback and MIC1 capture on the reference sample; processed phrase intelligibility does not qualify clean startup, general speech quality or sustained duplex.
GT9271 press/drag/release and landscape directions on the reference sample; one polled pointer, no multitouch or suspend/resume acceptance.
Powered four-port hub and one CDC serial device survive ordinary eMMC reboot; other classes and sustained transfers unqualified.
RTL8723DS discovery and bounded function-ready/restore only; no radio initialization or network interface.
